// tracecpu adds up, from an execution trace of the diagnostic of the inserts,
// the time the goroutines of the process were running, by what each
// goroutine is: told from the stack of whoever started it, or from its own
// the first time the trace has it. It also adds up, by the same groups, the
// time in system calls and the ranges the runtime marks on a goroutine (the
// help an allocation gives the collector, the sweep).
//
// Usage: go run ./tools/tracecpu <trace.out>
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/exp/trace"
)

const pending = "store cycles, not seen at work"

func frames(stack trace.Stack) []string {
	var out []string
	for frame := range stack.Frames() {
		out = append(out, frame.Func)
	}
	return out
}

// classify tells what a goroutine is from the functions of a stack: its own,
// or that of whoever started it.
func classify(funcs []string) string {
	has := func(subs ...string) bool {
		for _, f := range funcs {
			for _, sub := range subs {
				if strings.Contains(f, sub) {
					return true
				}
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	switch {
	case len(funcs) == 0:
		return ""
	case has("runtime.gcBgMarkWorker"):
		return "collector: mark workers"
	case has("runtime.bgsweep"):
		return "collector: sweep in the background"
	case has("runtime.bgscavenge"):
		return "collector: scavenger"
	case has("lsmkv.(*SegmentGroup).compact", "lsmkv.(*compactor", "compactOnce", "compactIfLevelsMatch",
		"lsmkv.(*segmentCleaner"):
		return "store: compaction"
	case has("FlushAndSwitch", "lsmkv.(*Memtable).flush", "flushAndSwitch", "atomicallySwitchMemtable"):
		return "store: flush of a memtable"
	case has("postingedge.(*Index).rescore"):
		return "plans: exact vectors (the goroutines of a rescore)"
	case has("postingedge.(*growIndex).fetch", "postingedge.timedRead"):
		return "plans: rows from the store (the goroutines of a round)"
	case has("postingedge.(*Persistent).AddBatch", "postingedge.(*Persistent).addInBatches",
		"postingedge.(*Persistent).searchWindow", "postingedge.TestDiag"):
		return "callers: the plans in line, and applying"
	case has("cyclemanager."):
		return pending
	case has("postingedge."):
		return "index, other"
	case has("lsmkv."):
		return "store, other"
	case has("runtime/trace", "traceAdvancer", "traceStartReadCPU"):
		return "tracer"
	case has("testing."):
		return "harness: the flush of every round, and the rest"
	}
	return "other: " + funcs[len(funcs)-1]
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: tracecpu <trace.out>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	file, err := os.Open(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer file.Close()
	reader, err := trace.NewReader(file)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	class := map[trace.GoID]string{}
	running := map[trace.GoID]trace.Time{}
	inSyscall := map[trace.GoID]trace.Time{}
	exec := map[trace.GoID]time.Duration{}
	syscall := map[trace.GoID]time.Duration{}
	type rangeKey struct {
		id   trace.GoID
		name string
	}
	open := map[rangeKey]trace.Time{}
	ranges := map[rangeKey]time.Duration{}
	var first, last trace.Time
	seen := false
	events := 0
	for {
		ev, err := reader.ReadEvent()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		events++
		if !seen {
			first, seen = ev.Time(), true
		}
		last = ev.Time()
		switch ev.Kind() {
		case trace.EventStateTransition:
			st := ev.StateTransition()
			if st.Resource.Kind != trace.ResourceGoroutine {
				continue
			}
			id := st.Resource.Goroutine()
			from, to := st.Goroutine()
			if from == trace.GoNotExist {
				// Its start function tells the workers of the runtime;
				// whoever started it tells the rest.
				if c := classify(frames(st.Stack)); strings.HasPrefix(c, "collector") {
					class[id] = c
				} else if c := classify(frames(ev.Stack())); c != "" {
					class[id] = c
				}
			} else if c := class[id]; c == "" || c == pending || strings.HasPrefix(c, "other: ") {
				// Its own stack, the first time the trace has it.
				if own := classify(frames(st.Stack)); own != "" && own != pending && !strings.HasPrefix(own, "other: ") {
					class[id] = own
				} else if c == "" && own != "" {
					class[id] = own
				}
			}
			if from == trace.GoRunning {
				if since, ok := running[id]; ok {
					exec[id] += ev.Time().Sub(since)
					delete(running, id)
				}
			}
			if from == trace.GoSyscall {
				if since, ok := inSyscall[id]; ok {
					syscall[id] += ev.Time().Sub(since)
					delete(inSyscall, id)
				}
			}
			if to == trace.GoRunning {
				running[id] = ev.Time()
			}
			if to == trace.GoSyscall {
				inSyscall[id] = ev.Time()
			}
		case trace.EventRangeBegin, trace.EventRangeActive:
			r := ev.Range()
			if r.Scope.Kind == trace.ResourceGoroutine {
				key := rangeKey{r.Scope.Goroutine(), r.Name}
				if _, ok := open[key]; !ok {
					open[key] = ev.Time()
				}
			}
		case trace.EventRangeEnd:
			r := ev.Range()
			if r.Scope.Kind == trace.ResourceGoroutine {
				key := rangeKey{r.Scope.Goroutine(), r.Name}
				if since, ok := open[key]; ok {
					ranges[key] += ev.Time().Sub(since)
					delete(open, key)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for id, since := range running {
		exec[id] += last.Sub(since)
	}
	for id, since := range inSyscall {
		syscall[id] += last.Sub(since)
	}
	for key, since := range open {
		ranges[key] += last.Sub(since)
	}

	type total struct {
		goroutines    int
		exec, syscall time.Duration
		ranges        map[string]time.Duration
	}
	by := map[string]*total{}
	at := func(c string) *total {
		if c == "" {
			c = "not told (no stack in the trace)"
		}
		if by[c] == nil {
			by[c] = &total{ranges: map[string]time.Duration{}}
		}
		return by[c]
	}
	ids := map[trace.GoID]bool{}
	for id := range class {
		ids[id] = true
	}
	for id := range exec {
		ids[id] = true
	}
	for id := range syscall {
		ids[id] = true
	}
	var all time.Duration
	for id := range ids {
		t := at(class[id])
		t.goroutines++
		t.exec += exec[id]
		t.syscall += syscall[id]
		all += exec[id]
	}
	for key, d := range ranges {
		at(class[key.id]).ranges[key.name] += d
	}
	window := last.Sub(first)
	fmt.Printf("%s: %d events over %.3f s; the goroutines ran %.3f s in all, %.2f cores\n", os.Args[1], events,
		window.Seconds(), all.Seconds(), all.Seconds()/window.Seconds())
	names := make([]string, 0, len(by))
	for name := range by {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Slice(names, func(i, j int) bool { return by[names[i]].exec > by[names[j]].exec })
	for _, name := range names {
		t := by[name]
		fmt.Printf("  %-56s %8d goroutines  ran %8.3f s  %5.1f %%  %5.2f cores | in system calls %8.3f s\n", name,
			t.goroutines, t.exec.Seconds(), 100*t.exec.Seconds()/all.Seconds(), t.exec.Seconds()/window.Seconds(),
			t.syscall.Seconds())
		rangeNames := make([]string, 0, len(t.ranges))
		for r := range t.ranges {
			rangeNames = append(rangeNames, r)
		}
		sort.Strings(rangeNames)
		for _, r := range rangeNames {
			fmt.Printf("      of which marked %-40s %8.3f s  %5.1f %% of all\n", r, t.ranges[r].Seconds(),
				100*t.ranges[r].Seconds()/all.Seconds())
		}
	}
}
